children: Overview
UK digital advertising provider's H1 revenue rose 2% yr/yr, returning to growth
Gross margin improved to 28.9%, supporting higher gross profit and reduced EBITDA loss
Revenue growth driven by expanded partnerships with CNN News and Associated Press
Outlook
Company says trading since the half-year has remained positive, with July-August revenue up 14% y/y
Dianomi expects cautious advertiser decision-making and structural changes to continue to present challenges
Company believes it is well positioned to pursue opportunities as the digital advertising market evolves
Result Drivers
PUBLISHER PARTNERSHIPS - Expanded relationships with CNN News and Associated Press began contributing to revenue from Q2 2026
NEW ADVERTISERS - Attracted 67 new premium advertisers, up 56% yr/yr, reflecting continued new business activity despite cautious market
PRODUCT INNOVATION - Launched Dianomi Interactive and invested in AI-driven tools, broadening product offering and supporting engagement
